UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
INVALID_URL: Enter a valid public Instagram, YouTube, X or direct video URL. Channel and playlist pages are not supported.
URL_NOT_ALLOWED: Videos cannot be imported from local, private or reserved network addresses.
INVALID_UPLOAD_TYPE: This upload format is not supported. Select a video or recording file and try again.
INVALID_FILENAME: The filename could not be read. Select the file again.
INVALID_VIDEO: The video could not be read. Use an MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV or AVI video, or a direct video file URL instead of a web page or playlist.
INVALID_VOICEOVER: The recording could not be read. Use an audio-only WebM or MP4/M4A recording.
VOICEOVER_NOT_FOUND: The recording was not found. Record it again or reopen the project.
INVALID_EDIT: The editing settings are invalid. Check clip timing, crop, text, audio and export settings, then try again.
INVALID_JSON: The request could not be read. Please try again.
NOT_FOUND: The requested video or export was not found. Its session may have expired. Import the video again.
REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: The request exceeds the configured server size limit.
FILE_TOO_LARGE: The video exceeds the configured import size limit.
PREPARED_VIDEO_TOO_LARGE: The prepared video exceeds the configured server size limit.
EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: The output exceeds the configured video size limit.
DOWNLOADER_UNAVAILABLE: The video download service is not ready. Please try again after the server setup is complete.
VIDEO_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE: The video processing service is unavailable. Check the server setup and try again.
SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The video URL could not be reached. Check that it is valid and publicly accessible.
UNSUPPORTED_VIDEO: Live streams are not supported. Choose a completed video.
VIDEO_NOT_FOUND: No supported downloadable video was found at this URL. Only the first item of an Instagram carousel is supported.
VIDEO_UNAVAILABLE: The Instagram video could not be retrieved. It may have been removed, restricted in your region or require sign-in.
INSTAGRAM_RATE_LIMIT: Instagram is receiving too many requests. Please try again later.
YOUTUBE_RATE_LIMIT: YouTube is receiving too many requests. Please try again later.
X_RATE_LIMIT: X is receiving too many requests. Please try again later.
YOUTUBE_AUTH_REQUIRED: YouTube requires sign-in or verification for this video. Choose a public video that does not require sign-in.
X_AUTH_REQUIRED: X requires sign-in or verification for this video. Choose a public video that does not require sign-in.
YOUTUBE_VIDEO_UNAVAILABLE: The YouTube video could not be retrieved. It may have been removed, restricted in your region or require sign-in.
X_VIDEO_UNAVAILABLE: The X video could not be retrieved. It may have been removed, restricted in your region or require sign-in.
DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT: The download exceeded the configured time limit. Please try again.
IMPORT_TIMEOUT: Video import or preparation exceeded the configured time limit. Please try again.
EXPORT_TIMEOUT: Video processing exceeded the configured time limit. Please try again.
TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS: The video URL contains too many redirects or an invalid redirect.
IMPORT_FAILED: The video file could not be saved. Please try again.
VIDEO_PROCESS_FAILED: The video could not be processed. Check its format and editing settings.
EXPORT_FAILED: The video could not be exported. Please try again.
EXPORT_NOT_READY: The video is not ready yet. Wait for the export to finish.
SERVER_BUSY: The server is processing other videos. Please wait for them to finish and try again.
SERVER_SHUTTING_DOWN: The server is shutting down. Please try again later.
MEDIA_LIMIT: The server's stored video limit has been reached. Close unused projects and try again.
EXPORT_LIMIT: The server's stored export limit has been reached. Remove previous exports and try again.
INTERNAL_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
